digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflows and dependency management (GitHub Actions, uv lockfile)
propositions: Land two dependabot PRs (#129 and #130) as a single Gerrit change grouping setup-uv v9→v10 bump and uv.lock botocore+json-repair patch updates
Replace 19 setup-uv SHA references across 11 workflow files from v9.0.0 (c771a70e) to v10.0.0 (ae62891f), with no breaking behavior change since all rebar workflows explicitly set enable-cache: true
Update uv.lock to botocore 1.43.70 and json-repair 0.63.1 by re-locking with exact version pins to match the certified PR scope (plain uv lock --upgrade-package resolved beyond the reviewed versions)
Verify gates pass: make lint, make typecheck, uv lock --check, and targeted usage-surface tests (test_structured, test_silent_success, test_llm_capabilities) against the bumped tree
